name: Pre-market range

definitions.definition_text: If you can be in front of charts by 7:00, do the exercise then; else same thing at 8:00–8:30; same thing at 9–9:30. That is your pre-market range — write it down; do not call it the opening range.
conditions: In that range: look for equal highs / equal lows (relative equals) prior to / left of the window for bias draw
invalidation: If both relative equal highs and relative equal lows present: wait for the first side to be disrupted, then work toward the other — that becomes bias
definitions.timeframe_session_context: NY local morning; 1m / 5m / 15m mentioned for scanning smooth locations
definitions.variations_note: Primary definition video for this concept in the local seed set.

definitions.definition_text: Pre-session / pre-market session time referenced as inside the 7:00 to 9:30 opening; a pre-session fair value gap may be used as an anchor when looking for participation lower after a premium open.
conditions: Context: premium gap open → bias bearish / look for shorts
May anchor off old fair value gap that's pre-session or one that forms during opening range
definitions.timeframe_session_context: 7:00–9:30 pre-market session; contrasted with OR-formed FVG
definitions.variations_note: Does not redefine the 30m pre-market windows; uses 'pre-session' FVG as an entry/anchor tool — keep separate from window definition.
